query:
*[_type == "society" && listed != false && slug.current == $slug][0]{
    _id,
    name,
    "slug": slug.current,
    province,
    region,
    founded,
    meets,
    venue,
    memberCount,
    description,
    logo,
    website,
    markBadge,
    contactEmail,
    contactPhone,
    committee[]{ role, name },
    facebookUrl,
    instagramUrl,
    annualShow,
    foundedPlaceholder,
    memberCountPlaceholder,
    meetPlaceholder,
    venuePlaceholder
  }

result.description: Established in November 1985 as a non-profit association, the TOG is an affiliate of the South African Orchid Council (SAOC) which is the governing body managed by a Board of directors nominated by all the different societies in the RSA. Membership is available to all people interested in orchids.
result.meets: Every 3rd Saturday of the month, 9:30 AM
result.name: Tygerberg Orchid Group
result.venue: Durbanville Library, Oxford Street, Durbanville, Cape Town
